looks.name: Freedom Cinema
looks.description: Room for your wallpaper with a quiet, focused app ribbon.

principles: One shared Home state and media player; a look changes presentation only.
Honor manual ink choices. Automatic uses stable wallpaper-region contrast with gentle shading.
No outlined letters or individual label plates. Focus surrounds the selected app card.
All eight selected apps can fit. Top, middle and bottom remain available.
No invented viewing progress, recommendations, live weather or account switching.
Every remote direction has a clear destination; Back closes the current surface first.
The existing layout remains selected until an experience is explicitly applied.
